Place_Por: Condado de Baqing, cidade de Nagqu, Região Autônoma de Tibete
Place_Eng: Baqing County, Nagqu City, Xizang Autonomous Region

Chinese: 地震報告: 根據地球物理氣象局初步分析，本地時間2026年10月22日22時33分39秒，於西藏那曲市巴青縣發生7.0級地震，震源深度約為10公里，震中約位於北緯32.40度，東經93.79度，距離澳門西北約2257公里。
Portuguese: Comunicado de sismo: A DSMG informa que no dia 22-10-2026 pelas 22:33:39 (hora local) foi registado um sismo de magnitude 7.0, profundidade 10 km, e cujo epicentro se localizou a cerca de 2257 km a noroeste de Macau, (32,40N, 93,79E), Condado de Baqing, cidade de Nagqu, Região Autônoma de Tibete.
English: Earthquake Report: Initial analysis from Meteorological and Geophysical Bureau indicated that an earthquake of magnitude 7.0 , focal depth of 10 km, has occurred at 22:33:39 on 22 October 2026 (local time) in Baqing County, Nagqu City, Xizang Autonomous Region. The epicentre is located near 32.40N, 93.79E, about 2257 kilometres northwest of Macao.
